actual_position_constraint.kind: mass-metric displacement QP and inelastic boundary impact
actual_position_constraint.scope: Every accepted 2 ms endpoint and its linear hinge path, including settling
actual_position_constraint.failure: restore prior integration state and raise; never silently accept invalid q
actual_position_constraint.physical_fidelity: Ideal joint stops; split from soft contact solve; not calibrated hardware or firmware

height_curriculum.rule: Existing frontier schedule and per-reset height sampling; every riser has the same sampled height.

environment_contract.platform_success: All feet inside the upper landing with 3 mm edge margin; foot surface clearance [-.025,.20] m; at least two supporting feet in .1 s; base clearance [.18,.60] m and tilt <45 deg.
environment_contract.stable_stop: Platform success plus horizontal speed <.05 m/s, absolute vertical speed <.05 m/s, every world angular speed <.1 rad/s and tilt <15 deg for 2 s.

action_contract.reference_anchor_bound_rounding: inward float32 to avoid affine boundary overshoot
action_contract.history: inverse-mapped post-clipping submitted target; float32 action
action_contract.initial_history: zero action at settled simulation pose; no hardware handoff simulated
action_contract.ppo_distribution: unbounded Gaussian; original sampled action and log probability retained
action_contract.reference_anchor: source mean projected to per-joint target-action bounds

target_commands.sampling: one sample per policy command proposal; strict guard may reject before application; no physics-boundary duplication

position_constraints.impulse_units: base translation N*s, all rotations N*m*s; not motor torque

startup_position_constraints.impulse_units: base translation N*s, all rotations N*m*s; not motor torque
startup_position_constraints.scope: one accepted endpoint per physics step; predictor diagnostics retained separately

profile.q_dq_boundary_semantics: SDK float32 boundary, strict outside comparison
profile.scope: application joint checks; not firmware readback or permission to actuate

guard.scope: All first episodes, including failures; pre-send/post-integration physics boundaries; no startup grace

calf_speed.scope: four named calves, actual velocity only; all supplied audit samples
